name: palette
description: Pi's color palettes for Codex: custom syntax themes, favorites, import/export and optional account sync.

interface.shortDescription: Themes and your Palette library in Codex
interface.longDescription: Use the same 34 palettes as Pi, add your own, save favorites and connect to palette.prjct.app on demand. Codex CLI uses its native /theme picker for syntax preview. Desktop color settings are provided as a recipe to apply in Appearance.
